body:
Suresh, here is a concrete draft for your corporate lunch package:

Mylari South Indian Cafe Corporate Bulk Thali (Indiranagar):
- 10-24 thalis @ ₹125 each (₹25 off retail) + free delivery
- 25-49 thalis @ ₹115 each + 2 complimentary filter coffees
- 50+ thalis @ ₹105 each + 1 starter platter
- Advance notice by 5pm previous day; delivery between 12:30-1pm.

We can target local office parks in Indiranagar. Want me to draft the 1-page menu flyer and WhatsApp announcement? Reply YES.

Padma, here is the draft structure for the kids summer program:

Zen Yoga Studio Summer Kids Program (Ages 6-13):
- 2-week module: Mon/Wed/Fri, 9:00 AM - 10:15 AM
- Curriculum: Posture, breathing coordination, and fun mobility drills
- Program fee: ₹2,499 per child (includes participation certificate)
- Batch limit: 12 kids for personal supervision

Want me to create the registration post and WhatsApp broadcast for current members? Reply YES.
Hi Aditya! Reminder from Karim's Salon in Alambagh: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow. Reply YES to confirm your slot, or let us know if you need to reschedule.

Namaste Riya! Beauty Lounge by Renu (Gomti Nagar) se reminder hai: Kal aapka appointment scheduled hai. Please 10 minute pehle arrive karein. Kya aap kal aa rahe hain? Reply YES to confirm, ya reschedule karne ke liye message karein.

Hi Ramesh, summer pattern alert for Malviya Nagar: Category data shows sharp demand movement (ORS demand +40, sunscreen demand +38, antifungal demand +45). Pharmacies in Jaipur are re-aligning front-of-counter stock to capture high-margin essentials. Want me to generate a 1-page fast-moving checklist and a seasonal WhatsApp catalog update? Reply YES.

Dr. Meera, IDA Delhi announced a clinical CDE webinar next week offering 2 credit hours (free for members). Key focus: precision treatment protocols and modern clinical workflow. Would you like me to pull the abstract and registration details for you? Reply YES.

Namaste Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy Malviya Nagar yahan. Aapki monthly medicines (metformin, atorvastatin, telmisartan) 2026-04-28 tak complete ho jayengi. Same brand pack free home delivery ke sath ready kar diya hai. Reply CONFIRM to dispatch, ya dosage badla ho toh call karein.

Hi Vivaan, Bright Smile Dental in Indiranagar here. Your prescribed oral hygiene and dental maintenance refill is due. We have packed your standard oral care kit ready for priority pickup or delivery. Reply CONFIRM to arrange dispatch, or message us if you have any questions.

Dr. Meera, heads-up: Smile Studio opened 1.3km away promoting Dental Cleaning @ ₹199. Rather than discounting, top-rated Lajpat Nagar peers retain patients through service bundles like Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Want me to draft a loyalty check-in WhatsApp for your existing roster? Reply YES.

Hi Suresh, heads-up: A new dining outlet opened within 1.2km in Indiranagar. Rather than competing on margin-eroding discounts, top Bangalore peers retain covers through service specials like Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149. Want me to draft a loyalty check-in WhatsApp for your existing regulars? Reply YES.

Hi Lakshmi! Quick check — what treatment or service has been most requested this week at Studio11 Family Salon? I will turn the answer into a Google Business highlight post plus a 3-line inquiry template for your staff. Takes 2 minutes.

Hi Suresh! Quick check — which dish or combo was your top seller this past weekend at Mylari South Indian Cafe? I will turn it into a Google Business showcase post plus a weekend special story. Takes 2 minutes.

Hi Rashmi 👋 Karthik here. It's been about 8 weeks — happens to most members at some point, no judgment at all. We've added a Tue/Thu evening HIIT class that fits weight loss goals well (45 min, 6:30pm). Want me to hold a free trial spot for you next Tue, 30 Apr? Reply YES — no commitment, no auto-charge.

Hi Reyansh! Friendly check-in from Asha Dental Care in Sector 17. Your regular visit is due, and we have open slots ready with Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Would you like us to hold a time for you this week? Reply YES.

Hi Reyansh! Daily Care Medicos (Alambagh) se quick check-in. Aapka monthly health essentials refill due ho chuka hai. Humne aapke orders ke liye Free Home Delivery > ₹499 ready rakha hai. Kya hum is week aapka refill dispatch karein? Reply YES to confirm.

Hi Anjali, it's been 38 days since our last chat. In that time, Glamour Lounge Spa & Salon generated 1200 Google profile views in Aundh. Local search volume in Pune is active, and 2 quick profile adjustments can boost your weekly call conversions. Want me to show you the 2-minute update? Reply YES.

Hi Anand, it's been 14 days since our last chat. In that time, Chai Point Cafe generated 2189 Google profile views in Sector 8. Local search volume in Chandigarh is active, and 2 quick profile adjustments can boost your weekly call conversions. Want me to show you the 2-minute update? Reply YES.

Hi Lakshmi, Diwali is coming up in 188 days. Businesses in Kapra that post festive packages early capture 2.4x more advance bookings. I have drafted a festive campaign featuring Haircut @ ₹99. Want me to send the draft for your review? Reply YES.

Hi Pooja, Diwali is coming up in 14 days. Fitness studios in Koramangala that launch a pre-festive conditioning challenge see 2x higher member attendance. I've drafted a 'Pre-Festive 14-Day Reset' featuring 3 FREE Trial Classes. Want me to post the announcement on Google Business and WhatsApp? Reply YES.

Hi Vikas, your Google Business Profile for Sunrise Medicos is currently unverified. Verified listings in Gomti Nagar see an estimated +30% higher call and direction volume. The verification process takes under 5 minutes. Want me to guide you through the instant verification steps right now? Reply YES.

Hi Suresh, heads up: DC vs MI tonight at Arun Jaitley Stadium. Saturday IPL matches typically drop dine-in covers by 12-15% as crowds watch at home. Skip the dine-in promo; instead let's push a delivery combo featuring your active menu specials. Want me to draft a delivery announcement and story graphic? Reply YES.

Hi Suresh, exciting news: Mylari South Indian Cafe is at 145 review count — just 5 away from crossing 150! Crossing 150 significantly improves your search ranking in Indiranagar. I have drafted a 1-line review request template to message your recent satisfied customers. Want to review it? Reply YES.

Hi Mukesh, milestone alert: Pizza Spot reached 787 profile views this month in Aundh, on track to cross 1000! To keep this momentum going, I've drafted a celebratory Google Business highlight featuring Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu). Want me to share the 2-line post draft? Reply YES.

Dr. Bharat, quick review: your calls dropped 50% over the last 7d compared to baseline. Top performers in Andheri West revive inquiries by refreshing their Google Business photos and highlighting Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. I've prepared a fresh post and call-to-action draft to restore traffic. Want me to share it? Reply YES.

Hi Sushma, performance check: The Beauty Bar recorded 22 customer calls over the last 30 days, trailing the Pune peer average of 28. Updating your listing with a featured package like Haircut @ ₹99 typically lifts inquiries by 25%. I've drafted a quick update to bring call volumes back up. Want me to share it? Reply YES.

Hi Padma, great momentum: your calls surged +15% this week, driven by kids yoga post. While local intent in Mylapore is peaking, let's lock in conversions with a limited-slot booking post. Want me to publish a celebratory update to capture more inquiries? Reply YES.

Hi Vikas, traffic alert: Sunrise Medicos generated 720 views this month, with strong search traction in Gomti Nagar. While customer discovery is high, let's convert views into walk-ins with a featured Google post on Free Home Delivery > ₹499. Want me to publish the post today? Reply YES.

Hi Priya, Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic (Lajpat Nagar) here. Aapka 6 month cleaning recall due ho gaya hai. Apke liye 2 slots ready hain: Wed 5 Nov, 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov, 5pm. Special offer: Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Reply 1 for Wed, 2 for Thu, ya apna suitable time batayein.

Hi Diya! Zen Yoga Studio in Mylapore here. It's been a while since your last session — your quarterly wellness check is due. We have reserved 2 priority refresher slots: Thu 7:00 AM or Sat 8:30 AM (First Month @ ₹499). Reply 1 for Thu, 2 for Sat, or tell us a time that works for you.

Dr. Meera, compliance advisory: DCI issued revised guidelines on DCI revised radiograph dose limits effective 2026-12-15, with implementation deadline 2026-12-15. We have summarized the operational requirements into a 1-page checklist for your clinic team. Want me to send the checklist to review? Reply YES.
